characters.description: A small, wiry green-skinned goblin raider, short and hunched, long pointed ears, big toothy grin, brass goggles pushed up on its forehead, a topknot of dark hair. Patched brown leather vest and wraps, a torn strip of deep blue academy cloth with a small gold star tied round its waist as a trophy, bare clawed feet. Holds a jagged steel knife in its right hand, crouched low and ready to run. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, brass, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.

A small, wiry green-skinned goblin raider, short and hunched, wearing a ragged deep blue academy hood with a small gold star, stolen as a trophy, long pointed ears poking out of it, sly grin. Patched brown leather tunic, a lumpy leather sack of loot on its back, cloth-wrapped forearms, bare clawed feet. Holds a curved jagged blade low in its right hand. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, deep blue cloth, a little brass. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.

A small green-skinned goblin archer, wiry and alert, long pointed ears, a dented leather cap with round red-lensed brass goggles over its eyes. Holds a short curved wooden bow in its left hand, a leather quiver of feathered arrows on its back. Patched brown leathers, a deep blue academy cloth scarf with a gold star worn as a trophy, bare clawed feet. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, brass, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.

A stocky, broad green-skinned goblin shieldbearer in a dented iron helmet, long pointed ears, scowling. Holds a big round shield in front of its body made from a scavenged brass machine panel: riveted brass plate with a small slotted vent grille and a little brass gear wheel on its face, a strip of deep blue academy cloth with a gold star hanging from its rim. A short iron-tipped spear in its other hand. Patched brown leathers, leather boots. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brass, iron, brown leather, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.

A lean green-skinned goblin hooker, long pointed ears, wild grin, brass goggles on its forehead. Holds a heavy iron grappling hook on a long iron chain, the chain coiled over its left hand and shoulder, the hook in its right hand ready to throw. Patched brown leathers, a deep blue academy cloth sash with a gold star worn as a trophy, leather wraps on its shins, bare clawed feet. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, dark iron, brass, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.

A hulking goblin chieftain, huge and muscular, broad shoulders, thick arms, roaring with tusked teeth, long pointed ears, olive green skin. Carries an enormous maul over its shoulder: a heavy square stone head banded in brass with a glowing violet rune carved on it, a long wooden haft wrapped in leather. Wears a necklace of small bones and skulls, a wide leather belt with a brass gear-wheel buckle, a ragged cape of furs and torn deep blue academy banners with gold stars, leather bracers, bare feet. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather and fur, brass, grey stone, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.

wizard.why: A wizard for scale at the bought art's density (60 px), to show what doubling the game's pixel density would look like.
wizard.description: A young apprentice wizard of a magic academy, slim, brown hair, wearing a deep blue robe with small gold stars and gold trim, a brown leather belt with pouches, brown boots. Holds a tall wooden staff topped with a small brass armillary ring holding a glowing violet crystal. Standing upright, calm and ready. Warm colours: deep blue cloth, gold, brown leather, violet glow. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.
wizard.note: A first run (aca66801) was cancelled mid-generation and charged 1 generation with no result.
